description: This file defines a custom exception class named CalendarEntityTypeNotSupportedException, which extends a generic resource not found exception. It is used within the calendar-related parts of the Fineract platform to signal that a certain calendar entity type is unsupported.

classes.name: CalendarEntityTypeNotSupportedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a specific calendar entity type is not supported by the system.
